_comment: Single source of truth for where this analysis's inputs live.
Every path may use ~ and $ENVVAR, and may reference an earlier key as ${key}.
Override the whole file with ALEPH_INPUTS=/path/to/inputs.json, or any single
key with its upper-case environment variable (e.g. TEMP_DIR=..., ISR0_FILE=...).
_isr_comment: The 2.5M-event PYTHIA 8.316 ISR-off/ISR-on samples are not ALEPH open data and are
NOT present on this machine (the pythia8316 example dir is gone). The correction
survives only as the cached ratio histograms below, which is enough to APPLY it.
Rebuilding it needs the samples regenerated; temp_isr{0,1}_* are 1000-event smoke
tests, not the production samples. Use --skip-isr and isr_cache_file instead.
